questions.q: Whom does Kumalo turn to 'for his enjoyment' while waiting for Msimangu?
choices: Gertrude's small serious son, whom he plays with and tells of the great valley
questions.explain: He is homesick, and reciting the names of hills and rivers to the child deeply satisfies him.

questions.q: Why is there never again much real talk between Kumalo and his sister Gertrude?
choices: She is much younger, only went to the fifth standard, and cannot speak with him of the deep things of Johannesburg
questions.explain: They exchange 'conventional conversation'; it is Mrs Lithebe she talks with, about 'things dear to the heart of women.'

questions.q: Who at Shanty Town first tells them she knew Absalom?
questions.explain: The nurse, in her red and white with her cap, directs them to the Hlatshwayos' house.

questions.q: What has become of Absalom, according to Mrs Hlatshwayo?
choices: He has gone home to Ndotsheni
The police took him away, and she heard the magistrate had sent him to the reformatory
He is working in the town
questions.explain: The Hlatshwayos had taken pity on him 'because he had no place to go.'

questions.q: Why was Absalom released from the reformatory a month early?
choices: Partly good behaviour and his age, but mainly because a girl was pregnant by him and he seemed anxious about the child
questions.explain: The reformatory even arranged the marriage, since both he and the girl 'had no people.'

questions.q: What had the young white man arranged for Absalom on his release?
choices: Work in the town, and a Post Office Book with three or four pounds saved in it
questions.explain: The reports of his work had been good, and 'I persuaded him to open a Post Office Book.'

questions.q: What kind of place is Pimville, where Absalom and the girl live?
choices: A village of half-tanks used as houses, set up years before 'in emergency' and used ever since
A hostel run by the church
questions.explain: A white man may not enter without permission at the gate.

questions.q: What does the girl tell them about Absalom?
choices: He went to Springs on Saturday and has not returned — and it is now Tuesday
He has gone back to the reformatory
questions.explain: She says it 'tonelessly, hopelessly, as one who is used to waiting, to desertion.'

questions.q: What bitter thing does Msimangu say to the girl?
choices: 'You must go back to your mother.'
questions.explain: He immediately regrets it and later asks Kumalo's forgiveness for his 'ugly words.'

questions.q: What does the young white man's telephone call to the factory reveal?
choices: Absalom has not been at work all week
questions.explain: He also checks with the Superintendent's office, confirming Absalom has vanished.
